The new Mochy
Sorry for the hassle!
Mochy is moving to a new app.
From 9.0.0 on, Mochy has its own signing key and a new app id, so the new Mochy installs as a separate app next to this one. Here\'s how to bring everything over:

Export everything here: your library, listening history, recaps, playlists, settings and modules. Logins don\'t come along, so you\'ll sign in again, and code modules need adding again in the new app.
Download and install the new Mochy from here. A copy is saved to Downloads too. You can keep this app as long as you like.
In the new Mochy, pick Import previous data during setup and choose the .zip you exported, and you\'re set!

Why is this change necessary?
Until now Mochy was signed with a debug key, the same kind of key every Android developer has. A key of its own means nobody else can make an update that passes for Mochy.
Android never lets an app change its key, so the new Mochy has to be a new app. Its new id means this one can stay installed, and you can export from it again whenever you want.
Sorry for the change and the hassle, we don\'t plan on doing this again <3
Thanks for using Mochy.
